title: Correctness: FIPS gate not first in set_iv, gen_iv, set_aad, set_tag handlers
description: In ioctl_set_iv(), ioctl_gen_iv(), ioctl_set_aad(), and ioctl_set_tag(), the ops->fips_gate() call occurs after fd_type and finalized/error state checks. Specifically: set_iv line 843 after fd_type check (833) and finalized/error check (838). gen_iv line 894 after same checks (884, 889). set_aad line 962 after same (952, 957). set_tag line 1049 after same (1039, 1044). The crypto2dev_provider.h contract lists set_iv, gen_iv, set_aad, set_tag explicitly in the set of callbacks that require FIPS gating before invocation. Per CLAUDE.md: the gate must be the first executable statement; checking session state before the gate allows a caller to observe branching behavior (e.g. -EINVAL vs -EACCES) that reveals session state without passing the FIPS gate, constituting a FIPS 140-3 violation. Systemic fix: move ops->fips_gate() to immediately after mutex_lock() in all six ioctl handlers.
close_reason: FIPS gate moved to immediately after mutex_lock() in ioctl_finalize, ioctl_reset, write(), read(), ioctl_set_iv, ioctl_gen_iv, ioctl_set_aad, ioctl_set_tag, ioctl_get_tag — using state->ops null-guard
